One input still open: Cognizant's year-3 run-rate assumes a 4% volume taper that Finance hasn't confirmed. Sensitivity holds the recommendation under ±20% volume — see Pricing. Not blocking, flagged for the record.
Why this recommendation

Three findings carried the decision

E-014Transition readiness: Cognizant scored 8.6/10 on the readiness benchmark with a full reverse-shadow phase; Infosys scored 5.9 with no reverse-shadow. Weighted 25% of the rubric.
E-022Normalized TCO: after the iceberg adjustment, the $1.81M headline gap narrows to $0.74M on a like-for-like 3-yr basis. Pricing E-022.
E-031Reference checks: two of Cognizant's three references ran comparable global delivery migrations on time; Infosys's strongest reference cited a 4-month cutover slip.
Risks on the recommendation

Three, with mitigations

Volume taper unconfirmed. Year-3 run-rate depends on a 4% taper. Mitigation: CFO confirmation gated into Selection; sensitivity band published.
Key-person dependency. Cognizant's named transition lead is non-contractual. Mitigation: name lock written into BAFO commitments.
Incumbent exit friction. 90-day parallel run overlaps incumbent wind-down. Mitigation: Transition stage KT plan sequences the exit.
